title: Mortgage Rate Watch Lender Comparison
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mortgage:rate
| stats avg(rate_pct) as avg_metric count as records by lender
| sort - avg_metric
description: Compares mortgage rate watch across lender buckets in one place.
value: Side-by-side comparisons help you see whether one lender, area, fee type, or jurisdiction looks meaningfully different from the rest.
implementation: Use stable grouping values and clean them during ingest so the comparison stays trustworthy.
visualization: Comparison table of average mortgage rate percentage by lender.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which lender buckets look best or worst for mortgage rate watch.
